description: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development & Cultural Affairs - Order made to notify that the Regulations made under the Registrations of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968 shall continue to be in operation upto 30.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains an order under the Registration of Persons (Amendment) Act, No. 08 of 2016, which extends the operation of certain sections of the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the legal order being issued rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
